solution:
As \(\sin\dfrac{\pi}{4} = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\) and \(0 \le \dfrac{\pi}{4} < 2\pi\), \(\dfrac{\pi}{4}\) is a principal solution.
By allied angle formula, \(\sin\theta = \sin(\pi - \theta)\).
\(\therefore \sin\dfrac{\pi}{4} = \sin\left(\pi - \dfrac{\pi}{4}\right) = \sin\dfrac{3\pi}{4}\) and \(0 \le \dfrac{3\pi}{4} < 2\pi\).
\(\therefore \dfrac{3\pi}{4}\) is also a principal solution.
\(\therefore \dfrac{\pi}{4}\) and \(\dfrac{3\pi}{4}\) are the principal solutions of \(\sin\theta = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\).

As \(\cos\dfrac{\pi}{3} = \dfrac{1}{2}\) and \(0 \le \dfrac{\pi}{3} < 2\pi\), \(\dfrac{\pi}{3}\) is a principal solution.
By allied angle formula, \(\cos\theta = \cos(2\pi - \theta)\).
\(\therefore \cos\dfrac{\pi}{3} = \cos\left(2\pi - \dfrac{\pi}{3}\right) = \cos\dfrac{5\pi}{3}\) and \(0 \le \dfrac{5\pi}{3} < 2\pi\).
\(\therefore \dfrac{5\pi}{3}\) is also a principal solution.
\(\therefore \dfrac{\pi}{3}\) and \(\dfrac{5\pi}{3}\) are the principal solutions of \(\cos\theta = \dfrac{1}{2}\).

We know that \(\cos\dfrac{\pi}{3} = \dfrac{1}{2}\).
As \(\cos(\pi - \theta) = \cos(\pi + \theta) = -\cos\theta\),
\(\cos\left(\pi - \dfrac{\pi}{3}\right) = -\cos\dfrac{\pi}{3} = -\dfrac{1}{2}\) and \(\cos\left(\pi + \dfrac{\pi}{3}\right) = -\cos\dfrac{\pi}{3} = -\dfrac{1}{2}\).
\(\therefore \cos\dfrac{2\pi}{3} = -\dfrac{1}{2}\) and \(\cos\dfrac{4\pi}{3} = -\dfrac{1}{2}\).
Also \(0 \le \dfrac{2\pi}{3} \le 2\pi\) and \(0 \le \dfrac{4\pi}{3} < 2\pi\). Therefore \(\dfrac{2\pi}{3}\) and \(\dfrac{4\pi}{3}\) are principal solutions of \(\cos\theta = -\dfrac{1}{2}\).

We know that \(\cot\theta = -\sqrt{3}\) if and only if \(\tan\theta = -\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\).
We know that \(\tan\dfrac{\pi}{6} = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\).
Using identities, \(\tan(\pi - \theta) = -\tan\theta\) and \(\tan(2\pi - \theta) = -\tan\theta\), we get
\(\tan\dfrac{5\pi}{6} = -\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\) and \(\tan\dfrac{11\pi}{6} = -\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\).
And \(0 \le \dfrac{5\pi}{6} < 2\pi\) and \(0 \le \dfrac{11\pi}{6} < 2\pi\).
\(\therefore \dfrac{5\pi}{6}\) and \(\dfrac{11\pi}{6}\) are required principal solutions.
